title: Exposure of sensitive information in PostgreSQL security_barrier processing allows a database user to infer values…
description: A vulnerability in PostgreSQL security_barrier processing allows a database user with limited privileges to infer sensitive information that should be hidden by a security_barrier view. This occurs by applying a leaky function to a CASE test value or internal parameter indirectly representing a protected column. Versions prior to PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
